newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy hard left hopes for accord on privatisations.
newsitem.headline: Italy hard left hopes for accord on privatisations.

text.p: Italy's hard-left Communist Refoundation is working with the government to try to reach an accord on privatisation policy, said Nerio Nesi, the party's economic spokesman.
He told reporters attending a conference that an overall consensus should be found regarding the future sale of energy group ENI, electricity utility Enel and telecoms holding company Stet.
"We have examined the situation and the three main problems - ENI, Enel and Stet (with the government). We are working together to understand each others' positions which are different," Nesi said.
"Refoundation and the government are trying to see if these positions can become less divergent...let's hope so," he said.
"ENI, Enel and Stet must be looked at together, the three sectors must have an overall solution," he added.
Refoundation says it is not opposed to all privatisations, just those it describes as nationally strategic sectors like energy and telecoms.
